name: H2
description: An H2 database server: checked read-only queries with row and time limits, always rolled back; changes wait for approval.

x-card.description: An H2 database server over its TCP protocol. Checked queries, always rolled back; changes wait for approval.

host.title: Host
host.description: The H2 server, started with h2 -tcp: h2.acme.internal, or localhost for one on this computer. Its TCP protocol isn't encrypted, so it must be on this computer or a private network the environment's policy allows.

port.title: Port
port.description: The server's TCP port (-tcpPort). The connector may connect to this host and port only.

database.title: Database
database.description: The database as the server names it: ~/orders, ./data/orders, /srv/h2/orders or mem:orders. GateRook never creates a database.

user.title: User
user.description: Best a user with SELECT rights only. H2 has no read-only transactions: an administrator could still read the server's files and run Java functions past GateRook's checks.

password.title: Password
password.description: Leave empty for a user without a password, as H2's sa often is.

options.title: Limits
options.description: Rows and time of each call. Policies can tighten them per environment.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Rows a query returns at most; the environment's row limit still applies

statementTimeoutMs.title: Statement timeout
statementTimeoutMs.description: H2 stops slower statements. Empty: the environment policy.

tools.name: h2_list_tables
tools.title: List tables
tools.description: The tables and views of the database by schema: kind, estimated rows and comment.

schema.description: Only this schema, for example PUBLIC

like.description: Only names matching this LIKE pattern (case-insensitive), for example ORDER%

tools.name: h2_describe_table
tools.title: Describe table
tools.description: The columns of one table or view with their types, nullability, defaults and comments, its primary key, foreign keys and indexes, and a view's query.

schema.description: The schema; needed when several schemas have a table of that name

tools.name: h2_query
tools.title: Run a read-only query
tools.description: Runs one query on the H2 server: SELECT, WITH … SELECT, VALUES, TABLE, EXPLAIN or SHOW. It may call H2's built-in functions only (not FILE_READ, CSVREAD, LINK_SCHEMA or the database's own functions), and runs in a transaction GateRook always rolls back, with row and time limits. Data change tables (FINAL TABLE …), NEXT VALUE FOR, FOR UPDATE, CALL, SET and JDBC escapes are refused.

limit.description: Max rows; the connection and the endpoint cap it

tools.name: h2_execute
tools.title: Change the database
tools.description: Runs one INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE, TRUNCATE, COMMENT ON or DDL statement on tables, views, indexes, sequences, schemas, domains, constants or synonyms, only after a person approved exactly this statement, and commits it once. Java functions, triggers, linked tables, users, rights, scripts, settings and functions that reach the server's files are refused. A change is never retried.

sql.description: One INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE, TRUNCATE, COMMENT ON or DDL statement. A person approves the exact text.

note.description: Why you need this change. Shown to the approver as unverified.
